papers.title: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics
papers.abstract: Surveys LLM agent systems that generate and iteratively refine graphics code, proposing a unified taxonomy for the field and a literature analysis system to track rapid research growth.

papers.title: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
papers.abstract: Uses earlier coding-agent trajectories to decide where new data collection effort should go, keeping that history out of the agent's context to avoid a train-test mismatch.

papers.title: PhotoGuider: Composition-Aware Cropping and 360° View Framing with Explainable Photographic Assessments
papers.abstract: Finds the best viewing direction in 360° panoramas and frames it using composition-aware scoring, with camera-parameter output and explanations for the framing choices.

papers.title: Order-Only On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Trains a student model to match the teacher's ranking of top tokens rather than its probabilities, which removes temperature tuning and improves math reasoning results.

papers.title: When Does Latent Prediction Error Support Physical Surprise Claims in Video World Models?
papers.abstract: Tests whether video world model prediction errors reliably signal physical impossibility, finding they often reflect appearance or motion instead of physical surprise.

papers.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
papers.abstract: Benchmark that scores LLM research proposals by how closely they match papers published later; LLMs match human communities on broad directions but lag on concrete approaches.

papers.title: LEANGUARD: Lean-Verified Guardrails for Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract: Runtime that checks each tool call from LLM agents against a Lean4 policy before execution, blocking forbidden actions and offering feedback or proof-guided repair.

papers.title: Cross-Primitive Consistency in Jev
papers.abstract: Introduces PrimaCons, a benchmark for whether LLM decisions stay consistent across query formats, and a residual calibrator that cuts that inconsistency by 58.57%.

papers.title: Multi-Agent Relay Thinking
papers.abstract: Multi-agent framework where reasoning is passed between agents, triggered by confidence and assigned through bidding, improving accuracy at much lower token cost.

papers.title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Open-source deep research agent that retrieves and reasons over rendered page images rather than OCR text, with counterfactual credit reweighting for training.

cc_updates.body:
What's changed

- Added a warning to `/schedule` when a new cloud scheduled task gets connectors you did not ask for, with how to remove them
- Added a check that asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address to the network
- Added `onFailure: "block"` for Agent SDK hook callbacks, so a callback that fails blocks the action instead of letting it run
- Added a notice in Claude Desktop's Code tab when your organization's remote managed settings haven't loaded for the session, and another once they do
- Added a notice when auto mode's check has no answer for a...

What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off
- Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with `pooled_budget` on the spend limits admin API
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
- Added `managed.policy_mode: layered` to the Claude apps gateway: every policy that matches a developer applies, each merged over the ones listed below it, not only the first
- Added `guardrail.input_tagging` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock...

What's changed

- Added `permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories`: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode
- Added an optional `groups` list to Claude apps gateway upstreams: only developers in the listed IdP groups are sent to that upstream, on failover too
- Added `guardrail_trace` to Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, to log which Amazon Bedrock guardrail filter fired on a request, without the matched text
- Added idle compaction to VS Code and Claude Desktop's Code tab: a 200K+ token conversation left idle is summarized, and the summary is used on your next message if the prompt cache has expired
- Fixed sessions failing turn after turn with "Invalid effort level" when an organization's admin caps a model's effort: Claude Code now lowers the effort, retries, and says which level it uses
- Fixed `claude -p` exiting with code 0...
